name: Alliant Energy
description: Alliant Energy is a holding company for two regulated utilities: Interstate Power and Light (IPL, Iowa) and Wisconsin Power and Light (WPL, Wisconsin). Together they sell electricity to about 1.0 million customers and gas to about 0.43 million. In 2025 electric was 84.8% of revenue, gas 12.0% and other 3.2% (computed). Regulators in Iowa and Wisconsin set rates to recover costs plus an authorised return (9.34% to 12.23% by asset in Iowa, 9.80% in Wisconsin), so profit grows as it adds rate base, with wind, solar and storage investment and, in 2026, new data-center demand. It also owns an interest in American Transmission Company (ATC Holdings, $41M of 2025 income).

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities' and Sub-Industry 'Electric Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.

hq.note: Principal executive offices in Madison, Wisconsin (FY2025 10-K)

employees.note: Full- and part-time; IPL 1,003 and WPL 992; 1,705 (58%) covered by collective bargaining (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Interstate Power and Light (IPL, Iowa)
businessLines.how: Customers pay state-approved electric and gas rates monthly; fuel and gas costs are largely passed through and profit is the authorised return on the rate base, which differs by asset (higher returns on certain wind and generating plants with advance rate-making principles).
businessLines.description: Electric (about 506,500 retail customers, $1,896M revenue) and gas (about 227,300 customers, $265M) utility in Iowa, also selling electricity wholesale into Illinois.

operatingProfit.note: Net income (the segment profit measure used by the CEO) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/352541/000035254126000007/lnt-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Wisconsin Power and Light (WPL, Wisconsin)
businessLines.how: Customers pay PSCW-approved electric and gas rates (forward-looking test-year rates) monthly; fuel costs flow through fuel-cost recovery, and profit is the authorised 9.80% return on retail rate base.
businessLines.description: Electric (about 505,800 retail customers, $1,801M revenue) and gas (about 206,000 customers, $260M) utility in Wisconsin.

businessLines.name: Other (AEF, ATC Holdings, Corporate Services, parent)
businessLines.how: ATC Holdings earns equity income from regulated transmission; the rest is parent-company interest and costs that the utilities' earnings must cover.
businessLines.description: Alliant Energy Finance and its non-utility investments, the interest in American Transmission Company (ATC Holdings), Corporate Services and the parent company.

operatingProfit.note: Net loss: ATC Holdings +$41M, non-utility and parent -$106M, plus other items (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/352541/000035254126000007/lnt-20251231.htm)
